purpose: 将 Disneyland Resort posted wait bootstrap 数据迁移到可治理的 PostgreSQL、API、预测和行程规划架构
global_acceptance: closed wait is null rather than observed zero
refurbishment and retired observations remain stored but are not training or planning eligible
web never accesses PostgreSQL or vendor APIs directly
no credentials or private data are committed
human_gates: create paid cloud resources or change budget
write production secrets or OIDC trust policy
first production database initialization and data cutover

phases.title: 数据语义与 catalog 生命周期
phases.objective: 把 posted wait、wait_capability、operational_state 和训练/规划准入写入版本化 contract。
acceptance: access_mode and wait_capability remain separate concepts
operational_state includes operating, refurbishment, seasonal, retired, unknown
catalog evidence fields are versioned
refurbishment, retired and unknown cannot be forecast or planning eligible
the additive catalog contract has a Node test and is included in npm.cmd run check
decisions: Do not modify normalized-wait-observation.v1 in this phase; changing its required fields would be breaking.
access_mode remains the observation vocabulary standby, single_rider, virtual_queue, other.
wait_capability is catalog metadata with exactly posted_standby, schedule_only, no_queue, unknown.
operational_state belongs to catalog metadata with exactly operating, refurbishment, seasonal, retired, unknown.
training_disposition has exactly eligible, ineligible_no_wait, ineligible_lifecycle, review_required.
planning_disposition has exactly eligible, schedule_constraint, ineligible_lifecycle, review_required.
refurbishment and retired require ineligible_lifecycle for both dispositions; unknown requires review_required for both.
Evidence must include source_type, source_url, verified_at and reviewed_by. source_type has official_disney_page, official_disney_app, manual_review.
The lifecycle record must include valid_from and nullable valid_to so reopening creates a new effective record instead of rewriting history.
Use node:test and node:assert only; do not add a third-party JSON Schema validator in this phase.
Add test:catalog to package.json and include it in the check script. Keep every change additive.

phases.title: PostgreSQL migration runner 核心
phases.objective: 建立带版本、checksum 和并发锁的 additive migration runner 核心及无数据库单元测试。
acceptance: migration discovery is lexical, additive and repeatable
applied migration filename and SHA-256 are recorded and a changed applied migration is rejected
concurrent runners are serialized with a PostgreSQL advisory lock
runner behavior has deterministic tests that do not require a live database
decisions: Do not edit infra/migrations/0001_observation_storage.sql; this task adds only the runner and its test.
Bootstrap infrastructure.schema_migrations before numbered migrations are discovered.
Use one PostgreSQL session for advisory lock, ledger checks and execution. Fail closed when an applied file checksum changes.
Import fileURLToPath explicitly. Track the primary error and lock acquisition so unlock failure never masks an earlier failure and unlock is not attempted if lock acquisition failed.
The ledger includes filename, SHA-256 and applied_at. Migration files manage their own transaction, matching 0001.
Expose core logic for a fake pool/client test; keep the CLI thin. Test lexical order, repeat skips, checksum mismatch, lock cleanup and module loading.

phases.title: Catalog 生命周期 schema 与 observation 索引
phases.objective: 只生成一个新的 additive migration，持久化 Phase 1 生命周期 contract，并增加基于真实列的 observation 查询索引。
acceptance: 0001 remains unchanged and only 0002 is added
lifecycle and evidence history are relational, effective-dated and linked to canonical_attraction_id
vocabularies and lifecycle dispositions match the Phase 1 contract
raw remains immutable and lifecycle history cannot be updated or deleted
indexes reference only columns present in 0001 and no table replacement or premature partitioning occurs
decisions: PostgreSQL CHECK constraints cannot contain subqueries; store evidence in a child table and put no EXISTS or SELECT inside a CHECK.
Do not use EXCLUDE or require btree_gist. Use a stable lifecycle_record_id primary key, unique canonical_attraction_id plus valid_from, and valid_to greater than valid_from when present.
Store contract_version and all Phase 1 fields. supported_access_modes is a constrained text array. Evidence rows contain source_type, nullable source_url, verified_at, reviewed_by and notes.
Enforce refurbishment and retired as ineligible_lifecycle for both dispositions, and unknown as review_required for both.
Reject UPDATE or DELETE on lifecycle and evidence history; corrections append a new effective record.
The normalized table has no park_id or snapshot_park_date. Add park/date/time indexes to ingestion.raw_wait_observations and only use real normalized columns.
Defer monthly partition conversion to a later online migration; targeted indexes are adequate for the initial 2-3 year hot window.

phases.title: Catalog 生命周期 schema contract test
phases.objective: 在现有 storage test 中追加已存在 0002 migration 的精简、确定性 SQL contract 断言，不修改 migration。
acceptance: test verifies 0002 lifecycle vocabularies and disposition rules against the Phase 1 contract
test detects any SELECT or EXISTS directly inside CHECK expressions
test verifies deferred evidence enforcement, append-only triggers, valid dates and indexes on real 0001 columns
test is concise, uses node:test only and requires no live database
decisions: Do not modify 0001 or 0002 and do not create a placeholder/new test file in this task.
Read the SQL and JSON schema as text/JSON. Avoid brittle full-file snapshots.
Assert there is no normalized index on park_id or snapshot_park_date because those columns do not exist in the normalized table.
Assert the lifecycle and evidence UPDATE/DELETE rejection triggers and the DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED evidence constraint trigger are present.

phases.title: PostgreSQL 17 helper 参数回归断言
phases.objective: 只在现有 0002 storage test 的 helper 断言旁追加两条断言，防止再次使用 PostgreSQL 17 会拒绝的 values text[] 参数名。
acceptance: existing 0002 test contains an assert.match for text_array_has_unique_values(input_values text[])
the same test contains an assert.doesNotMatch rejecting text_array_has_unique_values(values text[])
exactly two assertions are added and no existing test or fixture is duplicated or changed
the unified diff is minimal and passes git apply --check
decisions: Insert the assertions immediately after the existing supported_access_modes helper assertion.
Do not add a new test case and do not copy any existing test body.
Do not modify SQL or fixtures in this task.

phases.title: Migration runner 回填接入
phases.objective: 让现有 PostgreSQL 回填脚本使用共享 migration runner，并在现有 storage test 中添加回归断言。
acceptance: backfill calls the shared runner and no longer reads only 0001
existing --check behavior still avoids database and object storage connections
a deterministic existing-file test detects any return to hardcoded 0001 migration reads
protected bootstrap collector, analyzer and cache updater are untouched
decisions: Keep backfill CLI behavior unchanged except migration application.
Import runMigrations from infra/migrations/run-migrations.mjs and call it with the existing pool before the persistence transaction.
Remove only the direct readFile/0001 application code if readFile is no longer used.
Append a concise assertion to tests/storage/observation-storage.test.mjs; do not create a new test file.

phases.title: Storage npm scripts
phases.objective: 只修改 package.json，把 runner 和 storage tests 接入 npm check。
acceptance: scripts.db:migrate invokes the shared runner and no root-level db:migrate property exists
test:storage includes observation-storage and migration-runner tests and remains in npm.cmd run check
check:syntax includes the runner without removing existing files
decisions: Do not remove or rename existing npm scripts.
Add exactly db:migrate, append migration-runner.test.mjs to test:storage, and append run-migrations.mjs to check:syntax.
Do not add description or other package metadata and do not make no-op changes.

phases.title: Storage 基础设施中文文档
phases.objective: 只更新 infrastructure 中文 README，记录本地运行、checksum 与 partition 决策。
acceptance: README explains db:migrate, DATABASE_URL, ledger and advisory locking
README explains checksum mismatch fail-closed behavior
README labels three-year row count as an estimate and documents deferred partitioning
current implementation and future target are separate and no credential value appears
decisions: Document DATABASE_URL as required without a value.
Document roughly 10 million rows over a three-year hot window as an order-of-magnitude estimate, not measured fact.
Partitioning is deferred until measured table/index size and query latency justify an additive online monthly-partition migration; do not claim partitioning exists.
Do not rewrite unrelated infrastructure sections.

phases.title: 只读 restore verifier 核心
phases.objective: 最终修复现有 verifier：真正先建立 availableRelations，再安全检查 ledger，并删除遗留 hash 代码。
acceptance: the new file is a non-placeholder implementation exporting normalizeDatabaseTarget, assertSafeRestoreTarget and verifyRestoredStorage plus a direct-execution CLI
verification is read-only and rejects a restore target pointing to the same host, port and database as DATABASE_URL
it checks migration ledger, required relations, raw immutability triggers, lineage orphans and closed-wait semantics
it emits machine-readable run_id, checked_at, status, checks and failures
core accepts an injected client and CLI requires RESTORE_DATABASE_URL
implementation imports discoverMigrations and contains no hardcoded MIGRATION_FILES list
required relations are checked before dependent queries and an empty raw restore fails
CLI always ends its pool even when pool.connect fails
all to_regclass checks run first and every dependent query is gated by an availableRelations set
no relation name is interpolated into SQL and raw_counts passes only for positive archive and observation counts
source order places the complete required-relations loop before the ledger SELECT
missing infrastructure.schema_migrations adds failed migration_ledger with skipped_due_to_missing_relations and executes no ledger SELECT
createHash and sha256Hex are absent because discoverMigrations owns checksums
decisions: Operator creates/restores an isolated database; verifier never creates, restores, updates or deletes anything.
Normalize PostgreSQL URLs by lower-case hostname, default port 5432 and decoded database path; ignore username, password and query when comparing targets.
If DATABASE_URL is set and identifies the same target as RESTORE_DATABASE_URL, fail before opening a connection.
Run verification inside BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY and COMMIT; ROLLBACK on query failure.
Inspect pg_trigger/catalog definitions rather than mutating raw rows.

Check required relations with to_regclass, ledger filename/checksum validity, both raw immutability trigger names, normalized-to-raw orphan count, closed normalized rows with non-null observed wait, and raw archive/observation counts.
Expose normalizeDatabaseTarget, assertSafeRestoreTarget and verifyRestoredStorage for node:test; keep pg/environment handling in a thin direct-execution CLI.

phases.title: Restore verifier 核心单元测试
phases.objective: 把现有 placeholder 替换为精简 fake client、URL guard、healthy report 和 missing-relations report 测试。
acceptance: new test file is executable node:test code and is not empty or placeholder
tests cover same-target rejection across different credentials/query strings
tests cover a passing report and a missing-relations failed report
fake client supports every SQL query needed by those two report cases
tests use node:test and require no live database
decisions: Use a deterministic fake client that returns rows by recognizable SQL fragments.
Assert report contains run_id, checked_at, status, checks and failures. Keep this first file under roughly 180 lines.
Do not loosen verifier behavior or modify production code in this test phase.

phases.title: Restore verifier rollback 测试
phases.objective: 只向现有 restore verifier test 追加一个 unexpected query failure rollback 测试。
acceptance: test injects an unexpected query failure and asserts ROLLBACK occurs with no COMMIT
existing core tests remain unchanged and no live database is required
decisions: Reuse makeFakeClient, wrap its query method to record SQL and throw on the lineage orphan query.
Add no import and append only one concise node:test case.
Client release belongs to the CLI pool layer and is not part of this test.

phases.title: Restore verifier query safety 测试
phases.objective: 只追加一个测试，证明 healthy verifier 不发出任何写 SQL。
acceptance: test records a healthy verification's SQL and requires BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY plus COMMIT
test asserts no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE or pg_restore token appears
test adds no import, reuses helpers and does not change existing tests
decisions: Append exactly one concise node:test case and do not add or repeat imports.

phases.title: Restore verifier npm scripts
phases.objective: 只把 restore verifier 测试、syntax 和运行入口接入 package.json。
acceptance: scripts.db:verify-restore runs the verifier
test:storage includes restore-verifier.test.mjs
check:syntax includes verify-restored-storage.mjs
no existing script or package metadata is removed
decisions: All commands belong inside the scripts object.
Make only the three required script-string changes.

phases.title: 备份恢复独立运行手册
phases.objective: 最终清理现有 runbook：删除重复 4.1 标题/无用变量，让 aws endpoint 条件化并检查 CLI 退出码。
acceptance: runbook separates backup, isolated staging restore, read-only verification and cleanup
commands use environment variable names/placeholders and never credentials/private endpoints
S3-compatible sampling compares downloaded SHA-256 with ingestion.raw_archives.sha256
production restore, resource creation, secret entry and destructive cleanup are explicit human gates
no executable CREATE DATABASE or DROP DATABASE SQL exists
hosted staging creation uses provider console and local rehearsal references infra/compose.yaml
patch modifies the existing file and must not use new file mode or replace the whole document
archive sampling uses raw_archive_id, object_uri, sha256, byte_size, source_name, archived_at and contains no archive_key/archive_date
document contains no bash/export/sha256sum/rm -rf commands
section 4 contains exactly one 4.1 heading
aws endpoint-url is appended only when OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT is non-empty and LASTEXITCODE is checked
decisions: Use pg_dump custom format and pg_restore into a newly created isolated staging database; never restore over production.
Use npm.cmd run db:verify-restore after restore.
Raw sampling is read-only: select manifest rows, download chosen objects with provider CLI, calculate SHA-256 locally and compare; never update manifest.
Document cleanup commands as examples requiring explicit target confirmation, not automatic agent actions.
Keep provider choice optional; current provider recommendations are delivered separately with official citations.

phases.title: 迁移手册 restore checkpoint
phases.objective: 只更新 migration runbook，链接独立备份恢复手册并明确 Phase 2 checkpoint。
acceptance: runbook links the restore drill document
schema checkpoint requires db:migrate and isolated restore verification
hosted credentials and first restore remain human gates
no current missing-normalized-date blocker is removed
decisions: Keep existing migration stages and blockers; add references/checkpoints rather than rewriting history.

phases.title: Infrastructure restore 入口
phases.objective: 只更新 infra README，添加 restore verifier 和独立手册入口。
acceptance: README documents npm.cmd run db:verify-restore and RESTORE_DATABASE_URL
README links the detailed backup/restore runbook
README states verifier is read-only and cloud creation/first restore are manual
no credential value appears
decisions: Keep details in the dedicated runbook and add only a concise operator entrypoint to infra README.

phases.title: 目标 normalizer 历史重放
phases.objective: 为只有 raw、缺少 cleaned 的历史日期（2026-07-09 至 2026-07-12）用目标 normalizeWaitObservation 重放 normalized 记录，保留 raw lineage 并补齐缺口。
acceptance: replay is idempotent and produces no duplicate normalized rows
every normalized row keeps raw lineage
open missing wait becomes null instead of the legacy zero
closed rows keep no observed wait
missing normalized dates are explicit in the report
protected bootstrap collector, analyzer and cache updater remain untouched
decisions: Do not reproduce the legacy Number("") -> 0 behavior; open missing wait normalizes to null.
modules/observations normalizeWaitObservation is the single normalizer for replayed rows.
Replayed rows use a new transformation_version; legacy cleaned rows keep their existing version.
access_mode comes from the structured field; do not extend name-suffix inference.

phases.title: 历史重放 parity 报告
phases.objective: 比较文件与数据库的 raw/normalized 数量、hash、营业窗口覆盖、closed/0 语义与 canonical identity；任一日期语义不匹配则阻止该日期进入训练集。
acceptance: report is machine-readable with run_id, counts, failures and next steps
count, hash, closed/zero and lineage mismatches are explicit
a date with semantic mismatch is excluded and listed
report tests require no live database
decisions: Parity compares per-date raw/normalized counts, closed-vs-zero semantics and lineage, not byte-identical cleaned files.
The parity script is a new read-only CLI; it does not modify production data.

phases.title: 重放运行手册
phases.objective: 只更新 migration runbook：记录重放命令、幂等性、parity 门槛与 2026-07-09..07-12 缺口关闭条件。
acceptance: runbook documents replay commands and idempotency
parity gate and missing-date closure conditions are explicit
no credential or private endpoint appears
decisions: Keep existing migration stages and blockers; add the replay/parity stage rather than rewriting history.

phases.title: Source-envelope 实时摄取 use case
phases.objective: 在 modules/ingestion 建立 source-envelope 摄取 use case：来源、requested/observed/ingested 时间、payload hash、adapter/schema 版本与归因。
acceptance: third-party API access stays inside ingestion adapters
every envelope records source, requested/observed/ingested time, hash, version and attribution
outage or stale is an explicit state, not an empty success
adapter is injectable and tests require no live API
decisions: Ingestion depends on a catalog identity-resolution port; it never resolves canonical IDs itself.
Raw envelopes are immutable; ingestion does not update or delete raw records.

phases.title: 采集器双写
phases.objective: 在保留 Git fallback 的前提下，bootstrap 采集结果同时写入 hosted raw storage 与 PostgreSQL，用 feature flag 控制。
acceptance: bootstrap collector behavior remains characterized and unchanged
dual write is behind an explicit feature flag
Git fallback remains readable when hosted write fails
characterization tests still pass
decisions: Do not modify scripts/collect-wait-times.mjs semantics; add the dual-write path beside it.
Hosted write failure must not break the Git commit path.

phases.title: Source health 与双写验证窗口
phases.objective: 把 source health 写入 PostgreSQL，运行一个完整双写对比窗口并产出机器可读对比报告。
acceptance: source failures are visible in persisted source health
dual-write comparison covers a complete validation window
comparison report is machine-readable
decisions: Source health is derived metadata, not raw evidence; it may be updated.

phases.title: API 版本化 contracts
phases.objective: 为 parks、attractions、status、observations、forecast 与 health 定义版本化 OpenAPI/JSON Schema。
acceptance: request and response shapes are machine-checkable and versioned
web may depend on these contracts without database imports
consumers tolerate documented additive fields
decisions: Schema is the single source of truth; prose examples are explanatory only.

phases.title: FastAPI 用例编排
phases.objective: 实现 apps/api 的 use case 编排与依赖注入：catalog lookup、latest observations、health/freshness。
acceptance: API coordinates use cases instead of owning domain rules
health and freshness are observable
endpoints validate against the 05a contracts
tests require no live database
decisions: API entrypoints do dependency injection only; no business rules move into apps/api.

phases.title: API 降级与 fallback 测试
phases.objective: 数据源失败时 API 返回显式 stale/降级响应，并测试该降级行为。
acceptance: failure responses are explicit and carry freshness metadata
fallback never fabricates data
degradation is tested
decisions: Fallback is read-only; no fake rows are written back.

phases.title: Web 契约类型生成
phases.objective: 从 contracts 生成 web 类型，web 只依赖 API contract，不依赖数据库。
acceptance: web consumes versioned contracts
no database import or module internal import in web
generated types are not hand-edited
decisions: Generated types are build artifacts of contracts; hand edits are rejected.

phases.title: Next.js 渐进迁移
phases.objective: 静态站点渐进迁移到 Next.js；状态/园区页面改走 API，保留静态 fallback。
acceptance: web no longer calls vendor APIs directly
loading and stale states are visible
static fallback remains available
affected UI behavior has tests
decisions: Static pages stay available as fallback during migration.

phases.title: Forecast 版本化 contracts
phases.objective: 定义 forecast request/result、model/evaluation metadata 与 forecast interval 的版本化 schema。
acceptance: every forecast includes generation time, model version and input snapshot
30/60/120 horizons and interval shapes are representable
contract is versioned and additive
decisions: Forecast consumes versioned observation contracts only; never raw vendor JSON or UI state.

phases.title: 可复现预测 baseline
phases.objective: 实现确定性 posted-wait baseline（历史中位数/最近观测等）与 rolling-origin 评估。
acceptance: evaluation uses rolling-origin or time-based split; no random shuffling
reports MAE, WAPE, sample coverage and interval coverage
baseline is reproducible from versioned inputs
decisions: Baseline consumes only standby, open, eligible observations.
refurbishment, retired and unknown attractions are excluded.

phases.title: 预测 horizon 与降级
phases.objective: 输出 30/60 分钟预测及 120 分钟低置信参考；超阈值退化到最近观测基线并标记 fallback。
acceptance: 120-minute output is explicitly marked lower confidence
unavailable forecast degrades to a recent-observation or historical baseline with an explanation
fallback status is machine-readable
decisions: Do not fabricate precision when the model exceeds acceptable error.

phases.title: Planning 版本化 contracts
phases.objective: 定义 planning request、versioned itinerary、explanation、execution event 与 replanning request/result schema。
acceptance: itinerary carries generation time, algorithm version and input snapshot
one park and one service day per itinerary
versioned and additive
decisions: Itinerary input is a single park_id and a local service date; multi-park requires a new ADR.

phases.title: 规则 planner baseline
phases.objective: 实现规则 planner：feasibility、时间窗、步行图、schedule constraint 与可解释 fallback。
acceptance: refurbishment, retired and unknown projects are excluded
planner consumes catalog, observation, forecast and schedule contracts only
no-solution and source-failure paths degrade with an explanation
decisions: Planner never calls data sources directly.
Start with a rule baseline; OR-Tools comes only after the baseline is evaluated.

phases.title: OIDC 与 staging 部署
phases.objective: 建立 OIDC 短期凭证与 staging 自动部署。
acceptance: staging deploys only after deterministic checks
no long-lived cloud credentials in the repository
production environment is protected
decisions: Use OIDC short-lived credentials; long-lived keys are not committed.

phases.title: Canary 与自动回滚
phases.objective: 建立 canary 健康检查与失败自动回滚。
acceptance: canary health failure rolls back automatically
rollback is reversible and does not delete raw data
decisions: Rollback restores the previous deployment; data is never deleted.

phases.title: 首次生产切换人工 gate
phases.objective: 定义首次生产切换的人工确认、健康检查与回滚检查清单。
acceptance: first production cutover pauses for human approval
health check and rollback checklist are documented
stopping Git collection requires the documented gate
decisions: Production cutover, credential entry and stopping Git collection are human gates.
